title: Indus Capital AI Engine
tagline: Real-time KYC verification & risk underwriting automation pipeline
overview: Indus Capital needed to scale cross-border merchant onboarding from 4 business days down to under 8 minutes without sacrificing regulatory compliance. We architected a deterministic multi-agent verification pipeline that checks corporate registries, parses bank statements, and calculates AML risk scores.
challenge: Legacy KYC was reliant on manual human reviewers keying in passport scans, registry PDFs, and tax returns into outdated internal terminals. Bottlenecks triggered high merchant abandonment and erratic underwriting decisions.
architecture: Implemented an event-driven queue with Celery + Redis, Claude 3.5 Sonnet extraction agents, and a rule-based verification matrix with human-in-the-loop review thresholds. Outputs directly update core banking ledgers.

testimonial.quote: Deslopify eliminated our 4-day onboarding backlog in two weeks. Our merchants are blown away by the instant approval flow.
testimonial.author: Vikram Patel

title: Hush Contextual Support Agent
tagline: Autonomous Tier-1 & Tier-2 customer agent with dynamic tool execution
overview: Hush receives over 18,000 inquiries each month across device pairing, warranty claims, and Bluetooth firmware updates. We engineered an autonomous conversational assistant with sub-400ms latency, dynamic order lookup, and automated return label generation.
challenge: The previous chatbot relied on rigid intent trees that repeatedly looped and frustrated customers, forcing immediate human escalation and driving up operational support costs.
architecture: Engineered a hybrid semantic search vector index over all hardware documentation, paired with authenticated tool calling directly into Shopify and Zendesk. Strict guardrails prevent hallucinations.

testimonial.quote: Our customers genuinely believe they are speaking with our top hardware tier engineers. The speed and contextual accuracy is unmatched.
testimonial.author: Elena Rostova

title: Flyout Multimodal Document Pipeline
tagline: Automated OCR & customs declaration ingestion with 99.8% precision
overview: Cross-border air freight requires parsing thousands of multi-lingual customs manifests, bill of ladings, and commercial invoices. Flyout's manual entry was plagued by transcription errors and customs clearance fines.
challenge: Documents arrived in degraded faxes, skewed mobile phone captures, and mixed languages. Traditional OCR regex templates repeatedly broke on unseen layouts.
architecture: Deployed a vision-language processing pipeline using Claude 3.5 Sonnet Vision with coordinate-level spatial normalization, tabular reconciliation, and structured Pydantic schema validation.

testimonial.quote: We went from 6 clerks typing invoice numbers all night to a zero-touch pipeline that finishes before the plane touches down.
testimonial.author: Marcus Vance

title: JustGains Real-Time Biometric Copilot
tagline: Predictive fatigue analytics & personalized training generation
overview: JustGains is a mobile athletic performance platform. We designed and engineered their real-time biometric copilot, which ingests Apple HealthKit and Whoop telemetry to dynamically adapt workout intensity and recovery protocols.
challenge: Users were overwhelmed by raw charts and uninterpreted numbers. The client needed actionable daily guidance delivered with the voice of an elite Olympian strength coach.
architecture: Built an edge ML pipeline combining local device feature extraction with low-latency LLM synthesis, generating personalized audio and visual daily workout recommendations.

testimonial.quote: Deslopify took our messy beta dashboard and turned it into an award-winning iOS experience that Apple featured on the App Store.
testimonial.author: Samir Kassam

title: Founder Copilot Executive Command
tagline: Unified portfolio telemetry & automated board report generation
overview: Venture partners needed an automated intelligence dashboard aggregating Stripe metrics, churn signals, customer NPS, and runway calculations across 45 portfolio companies with executive-ready weekly summaries.
challenge: Partners spent their entire weekends manually cross-referencing Stripe dashboards, Google Sheets, and Slack updates to construct weekly investor memorandums.
architecture: Integrated unified webhook ingestors, automated time-series anomaly detection algorithms, and Claude-powered markdown briefing generators with export to PDF and Notion.

testimonial.quote: It is like having a Chief of Staff and data analyst working 24/7. We catch churn risks weeks before they hit the financial statements.
testimonial.author: Claire Chen

title: Sakurail Rail & Fleet Orchestrator
tagline: Autonomous multimodal freight scheduling & predictive delay avoidance
overview: Sakurail coordinates intermodal freight corridors across rail, truck, and maritime nodes. We modernized their legacy dispatch console into an intelligent, proactive control center with autonomous conflict resolution.
challenge: Dispatchers navigated 9 different green-screen mainframe windows while on phones with station masters, resulting in misrouted railcars and costly idling penalties.
architecture: Unified legacy TCP socket streams into modern GraphQL subscriptions, paired with an AI-driven routing optimizer that flags weather and maintenance delays in advance.

testimonial.quote: The new control interface gave our dispatch team superpowers. We eliminated railcar bottlenecks across all three major transport corridors.
testimonial.author: Kenji Sato
